refresh.reproduction: A login omitting offline_access succeeds; refreshing with the scopes added by RMCP returns invalid_scope, scope=offline_access.
refresh.policy: Request offline_access at login; default an omitted authorization prompt to consent before provider scope validation. Preserve explicit prompt=none and the refresh scope subset check. Old credentials must reconnect; no grant is widened.
refresh.tests: All five actual login commands read from the CS/EN guides and README complete native tenant consent, reject scope widening, rotate refresh credentials twice, and call MCP successfully.
